candidate_direction: session registry plus subject-scoped runtime disambiguation, using existing Essence/Projection/AST execution

Entity.identity_policy: Fully qualified ordinal ID; display text is not identity; no ID reuse or silent rebind. Generation is needed only if later reuse is explicitly approved.

Facet.engine_private_binding: FacetId -> existing reality Projection; subject + FacetId -> private mental Projection
Facet.policy: Many Facets may share an Entity. Identity sharing is not an automatic cognitive fact. Do not replace a selected Facet with Representations.FirstOrDefault.

Referent.policy: Authored ID resolution and cognitive word resolution are separate. Proposed lexeme normalization is NFC only; preserve raw spelling; do not normalize stable IDs or silently collapse collision candidates.

Interpretation.policy: Resolve only from that subject's immutable cognitive frame. Zero recognized candidates is Unrecognized; multiple is Ambiguous. A unique result becomes the existing Noun.Reference. WorldRuntime reality is never used as a cognitive disambiguation oracle.
Interpretation.output_boundary: MentalHandle does not expose Essence, objective EntityId binding, or other subjects' private projections.

required_new_contracts.request: Explicit Entity/Facet/Referent IDs, per-subject candidate sets, and a declared lexeme collision/normalization policy; replace the current one-projection bridge without inventing new entity enums.
required_new_contracts.core_semantic_addition: None needed for basic Project/Observe/embedded-Noun/Change composition; author/runtime schema remains a new production contract requiring approval.

required_new_contracts.request: Monotonic KnowledgeRevision for every committed Observation batch, plus either an atomic immutable read frame used by Ast.Evaluate or a shared read/write boundary forbidding updates during evaluation.
required_new_contracts.core_semantic_addition: Required if public Core evaluation must remain coherent under concurrent cognitive updates. A WorldSession-only gate provides only a narrower guarantee. History.Count and choice-token Version are not KnowledgeRevision.

required_new_contracts.request: Define whether Inspect addresses the selected facet or the entity's default manifestation. Facet-preserving Inspect requires an exact originating-facet binding lookup; current code inspects the first manifestation.
required_new_contracts.core_semantic_addition: Required only if selected-facet inspection is chosen. No new causal mechanic is justified by this audit.

required_new_contracts.request: Versioned immutable mental snapshots or complete versioned deltas with stable mental handles; explicitly decide Forget retention. Save reconstruction, AST link repair and scheduler restoration require a real codec and historical save fixtures.
required_new_contracts.core_semantic_addition: Current ObservationEvent does not retain complete historical state. This is a new data/lifecycle contract. Historical save support remains NOT_VERIFIED.

required_new_contracts.request: Typed distinctions for UnknownLexeme, Unrecognized, Ambiguous, StaleInterpretation, MissingObject and UnsupportedCapability; approve whether an accepted intent keeps its binding after target Forget or must revalidate the cognitive revision at activation.
required_new_contracts.core_semantic_addition: Diagnostic wrapping can be host-only. Mandatory target-forget invalidation or activation-time revision revalidation changes Core behavior and requires approval.

required_new_contracts.request: IR declares required capabilities and versions, loader rejects unsupported Entity/Facet/Interpretation features before mutation, and approved features have explicit records.
required_new_contracts.core_semantic_addition: No evidence that such a machine-readable Core capability contract exists. F01 audit metadata is not executable negotiation.

historical_save.reason: No historical save fixture or codec supplied; in-memory chapter continuity is not a save round-trip.

design_compliance: NOT_EVALUATED: no project design documents were read; parent must make content/design tradeoffs.
